class.name: NNBTSequence
class.brief_description: Runs child branches in order until all succeed, or fails as soon as one fails.
class.description: Use to build ordered multi-step tasks (such as check condition, move to target, then attack). Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] when every enabled child succeeds, [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while a child is running, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] immediately if any child fails. Enable [member reactive] if earlier condition checks must keep passing on every tick while a later step is running. To resume from a failed step on the next run instead of restarting from the beginning, use [NNBTSequenceStar].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], restarts from the first child on every tick instead of resuming the previously running child.
